PLAN-REVIEW.description: Read the current-source architecture/handoff, confirm original intent, source owners, alternatives, risks, pending runtime evidence and ordered Sol tasks; record the actual owning PR, immutable file and dated issue anchor. This gate concerns planning delivery only; it requires no invented independent implementation review.

WORLD-ARRIVAL.description: Pending implementation. Add deterministic projection/inverse, finite near-plane, exact terminal and retarget tests; preserve world/camera/phase identities. Inspect exact-source forward/reverse/nonadjacent Day/Night desktop/narrow motion and obtain maintainer visual acceptance. A screen-center overlay or generic baseline pass is insufficient.

FRAGMENT-FIDELITY.description: Pending implementation. Add partition coverage/no-overlap/seed/size/resource tests and real partial-glyph, whole-glyph, word, transparent portrait and inline SVG fixtures. Inspect current-source font/shaping/wrapping/crop/alpha/seam captures. Text-only or card-only animation cannot satisfy the issue.

NATIVE-DESTINATION.description: Pending implementation. Add exact native terminal/scroll/history/anchor/filter/cancellation assertions and current-source browser selection/click/focus/announcement/zoom observations. Original DOM, metadata and shared reading paint must remain intact, decorative IDs/semantics safe and all fragment nodes removed.

LIFECYCLE.description: Pending implementation. Exercise the actual new manager with stale navigation, decode/font/geometry failure, Off/reduced/hidden/print, resize/theme, retarget and cleanup cases. Add named runtime tests before readiness and verify bounded source-matched browser fallback behavior, one existing clock and no stuck hidden/inert content.

PERFORMANCE.description: Pending implementation. Add resource/lifetime/idle-work checks, then retain the bounded same-environment paired prototype flights and representative browser paint/compositing traces. Keep original byte/geometry/Lighthouse/motion/flight budgets and report native Safari/iPad evidence or its absence. Current callbacks alone are not GPU/display-FPS evidence; a planning CI pass is no performance measurement.

IMPLEMENTATION-DELIVERY.description: Pending implementation. Replace AC02-AC06 preparation-only scope with meaningful executable runtime mappings; regenerate required canonical/public/offline/RI output, classify tests, obtain exact-source required CI/preview, independent review, maintainer visual decision and applicable bounded staging evidence. Reconcile the actual issue-body checkboxes; do not close on this planning PR.

MERGE.description: Record the applicable maintainer decision, accepted runtime candidate normal merge and exact merged-source reconciliation. This planning session authorizes no runtime rollout, stable staging or production activation.
